# Tapfiliate

Tapfiliate is an affiliate and referral tracking platform that enables businesses to create, track, and scale their affiliate programs efficiently.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tapfiliate/.

## Actions

- **Create a Payment**: Create a payment.
- **Delete an affiliate**: Delete a specific affiliate.
- **List all affiliates**: List all affiliates.
- **List all affiliates**: List all affiliates.
- **List all commissions**: Retrieve all commissions.
- **List all payments**: List all payments.
- **List all payout methods**: Retrieve a list of all payout methods for an affiliate.
- **List all programs**: List all programs.
- **Retrieve a Payment**: Retrieve details of a specific payment.
- **Retrieve an Affiliate**: Retrieve details of a specific affiliate.
